bounded_repeatability_control.limits: Same fitted BF16 checkpoint and worst B8 fitting microbatch, no training or precision conversion. Exact repeatability is checked separately for every compiled program. The native coefficient-return API adds no hand-written generator statistics. Materialized-logit controls return additional arrays and may themselves compile differently from their NLL-anchor programs; their loss changes are recorded rather than conflated with the original discrepancy.

generator_change.limits: Before and after coefficients are captured from each generator's own causal native forward, so later-layer inputs also change. Parameter differences are accumulated changes, not Adam update estimates from gradient norms.

gradient_coordinate: u_r=r!c_r; error-vector norms are pooled across selected layer/head/query rows
interpretation_limits: Generator statistics average the instrumented B256 forward; its failed per-sequence parity bound remains visible. The VJP/conditioning probe covers only sequence0 and uses instrumented-execution cotangents.

Uniform samples and deliberately minimum-RMS samples are separate. Query0 has one causal key and theoretical basis-output rank at most1; its nearly zero directional derivative makes relative ratios and floating-point rank estimates unreliable. Excluding it is explicitly reported, not silently selected.

Native-output tangent geometry evaluates the smooth RMS Jacobian at the captured rounded output. Smooth-FP64 geometry evaluates it at T*u. Neither includes the coefficient generator Jacobian or represents a whole-model Hessian.

Coefficient tangent singular values measure changes in u; angular-direction singular values multiply them by ||u||. Fixed-ray radius is excluded from tangent conditioning but its response is reported separately.

FP32 controls change the attention backend to blocked as well as arithmetic. Improved parity supports precision/execution sensitivity, but does not isolate a compiler operation or prove the cause of the optimization gap.

Small pooled kernel-only coefficient-VJP discrepancies are evidence against a concrete backward-kernel error on sampled tensors; they do not prove correctness at every checkpoint or determine B256 clipping causes.

after.cotangent_execution: Instrumented compiled execution with capture/native NLL discrepancy beyond the established bound; these are not claimed to be the native checkpoint's exact cotangents.

fp32_blocked_capture_parity.interpretation: Same before/after checkpoint arrays and sequence. Native and instrumented graphs both use FP32 module arithmetic with blocked attention. The loss is not required to equal BF16 checkpoint NLL; changing the backend as well as arithmetic prevents attributing any difference to one precise cause.

before.cotangent_execution: Instrumented compiled execution; native/capture NLL agrees within the established bound, but bitwise identity is not asserted.

fp32_blocked_capture_parity.interpretation: Same before/after checkpoint arrays and sequence. Native and instrumented graphs both use FP32 module arithmetic with blocked attention. The loss is not required to equal BF16 checkpoint NLL; changing the backend as well as arithmetic prevents attributing any difference to one precise cause.
